title: The Lair Maw
truth: A cave mouth opens in the rock, screened by a lattice of dragged thornbrush that has been dead long enough to go grey.
Bones, both animal and otherwise, are scattered outside the entrance where they were thrown rather than buried.
Three goblins keep watch from the rocks above the entrance, bored and inattentive rather than alert.
npc_intent: The goblins want to be left alone to finish their watch shift without their boss noticing they slacked; they will fight only once they realise they have been seen, and will otherwise shout a warning down into the lair.
consequences: A loud approach — shouting, a fight in the open, a fall on the loose scree — is heard inside the lair, and whatever is below has time to arm itself before the player arrives.
A goblin allowed to flee downward reaches the boss first, and the boss is ready rather than surprised.

hidden.fact: A second, smaller gap in the rock to the side of the main entrance is not watched at all and leads to the same chamber below.
hidden.discovered_by: a Wisdom (Perception) check on the rock face, or deliberately searching the outcrop for another way in before approaching the main entrance

exits.description: A downward scramble over loose scree into the dark of the cave.
